answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by tying influence to a slashable bond, not to the count of identities. Each new agent locks real collateral and gets vouchers from already-bonded peers, so a web of trust links every bond to a unique key. Cloning yourself into many fake accounts never multiplies the stake behind them. Even an attacker forging a jade credential or hiding a lotus garden of sock-puppets still needs that locked capital, forfeited the moment fraud is found. Honest agents gain a safe haven: attacking costs more than any single forged voice could earn.
